subject: geography
title: Representation of Places
meta_desc: A-Level Geography adventure on place representation, statistics and qualitative sources.

concepts.def: Numerical: census, ONS data, IMD scores.
Decennial UK survey; 2021 census complete; cost £900 million.
Index of Multiple Deprivation; ranks small areas (LSOAs).
Active promotion via slogans, brands; 'I Love NY'.

walkthroughs.body_html: UK Census 2021: 56.5 million people in England and Wales; 84 percent urban. ONS data covers life expectancy gap: 9.5 years between richest and poorest London boroughs. IMD 2019 ranks Jaywick (Essex) as most deprived LSOA in England. Crime stats from police.uk.

Daniel Defoe's Tour Through Great Britain (1724-26) captured early modern places. Charles Booth's London poverty maps (1898). Modern: BBC documentaries, novels (Zadie Smith's NW), music (Arctic Monkeys' Sheffield). Each offers situated knowledge.

Manchester rebranded as 'Original Modern'; Northern Powerhouse since 2014. Marketing budget £6 million annually. Iconic projects: Etihad Stadium, MediaCity, Beetham Tower. Critics: marketing masks deprivation in Gorton and Cheetham Hill. Brand vs lived experience tension.
